findings.finding: ActionAdapter is only an execute and reconcile Protocol; no immutable adapter definition binds capability, account kind, schemas, risk, idempotency domain, timeout, usage, webhook, version or readiness.

the canonical Action adapter boundary has no dryValidate operation, so account permission, object scope, quota, capacity, estimated cost, reversibility and provider readiness cannot be proven before approval.
no shared parameterized conformance suite was found that every production adapter must pass; current tests register local fake adapters directly.
ActionAdapter receives and returns untyped dictionaries; the execution boundary does not validate signed input, provider output, Receipt payload or semantic status against exact schemas.
there is no contract-level trusted AccountRef and secret resolver; tests bypass the account and secret boundary entirely.

ResearchJob contains useful callback signature and nonce patterns, but the canonical Action chain has no tenant-scoped signed webhook inbox linked to ActionReceipt; the legacy action-webhook engine is a separate surface and cannot be adopted as authority.
AIP has a separate UsageReceipt authority and provider usage bridge, but Action execution does not require or link a measured, estimated or unknown usage receipt.
Action outcomes support accepted, applied, failed and unknown only; batch partial, cancellation capability, cancellation receipt and partial reconciliation are absent.
unexpected exceptions collapse to failed and invalid statuses to unknown without a signed provider-neutral reason taxonomy, retry safety declaration or redaction contract.
there is no gate proving that a registered production adapter revision passed the exact contract suite before its CapabilityBinding can become available.

reusablePatterns: AIP Action single-attempt lease, immutable initial and reconcile receipts, no automatic retry
ResearchJob signed callback timestamp, nonce and provider reread patterns
CapabilityRevision and CapabilityBinding exact ref, health, quota, network and secret-ref contracts
AIP UsageReceipt measured, estimated and unknown quality separation
existing tenant isolation, marking and idempotency conflict conventions
requiredSuiteDimensions: input, output, receipt and usage schemas
account, secret, tenant and marking isolation
dryValidate and drift between validate, approve, lease and execute
idempotency replay and same-key payload conflict
rate, capacity, timeout, accepted, applied, failed and unknown
reconcile by trusted provider reread without blind retry
partial batch, cancel and compensation capability declarations
signed webhook inbox, replay window, nonce, ordering and deduplication
kill switch, budget reservation and UsageReceipt settlement
redaction and zero secret or PII leakage
publish gate and rollback to the prior installed adapter revision

verification.interpretation: reusable safety fragments are stable, but there is no single canonical Action adapter conformance suite or production publish gate
